div.p: RE- ENTRY PERMIT FOR STAYING OUTSIDE UAE OVER 6 MONTHS

Individuals holding UAE Residency Visas, who are required to stay outside the UAE for extended periods exceeding six months due to study, work, or medical treatment, have the option to apply for a re-entry permit. This permit allows them to enter the UAE during their absence and remains valid for a period of 30 days from the date of approval.

ol.li: The application must be submitted from outside the country.
The client can apply for this request after (180) days of staying outside the country.
When the application is approved, the applicant must enter the country within (30) days starting from the approval date.
A valid reason must be provided to justify being outside the country for more than (180) days.
A fine of (100) dirhams will be charged for every (30) days or less spent outside the country.
